newsitem.title: USA: Kimmins sees "very strong" H2 oper results.
newsitem.headline: Kimmins sees "very strong" H2 oper results.

text.p: Kimmins Corp, reporting record revenues in the second quarter, said Tuesday it expected a strong performance for the second half.
"We look forward to very strong operating results for the remainder of 1997," said chairman and president Francis Williams in a statement.

The contractor's revenues soared 35 percent to a record $37.0 million in the quarter ended june 30, from $27.4 million last year. Kimmins posted a $876,000 net income, or $0.20 a share, in the quarter, comparwed with a $228,000 net, or $0.05 a share, the year before.

"The decision that we made to close our Northeast operations during 1996 and refocus our resources within the Southeast has resulted in the strongest revenues in any three-month or six-month period in our history," Williams said.

He added "very strong performance" by the company's Specialty Contracting group and "significant growth" in its Mining Services group more than offset the loss of the Northeast revenues and margin pressure at its 74-percent owned subsidiary TransCor Waste Services Inc.
The company's stock hit a new 52-week high of 5 Tuesday morning, up 9/16.
